summary: First-finish smoke tests for Ummah Visibility Analyzer. All 6 backend endpoints and all frontend testids requested in the review pass. Full /api/analyze completed in ~15s (well under the 90s budget) and returned the exact expected shape (overall_score, 5 cluster_scores each with cluster_id/label/visibility_pct/recommendation, 3 engine_scores for gpt/claude/gemini, 10 questions each with engine_answers containing mentioned+snippet for all 3 engines). Landing form, results page (score, radar, engine chart, 5 cluster tiles, questions accordion), history page navigation, and download report all work. No console/page errors.
passed: GET /api/config -> 200 with 5 clusters + 3 engines (gpt, claude, gemini)

POST /api/analyze valid input -> 200 in ~15s; overall_score=0 (int), 5 cluster_scores with recommendation, 3 engine_scores, 10 questions with engine_answers[{gpt,claude,gemini}] each having {mentioned, snippet}
POST /api/analyze with empty fields -> 400 with detail 'entity_name, location and category are required'
GET /api/analyses -> 200 returns list with id, entity_name, location, category, overall_score, created_at
Landing (/) shows analyze-form, input-entity-name, input-location, select-category, input-website, submit-analyze
Form inputs accept typing (no focus loss)
/results/{id} shows results-page, overall-score, radar-chart, engine-chart, all 5 cluster-{id} tiles, questions-accordion, download-report
/history shows history-page and history-item-{id}; clicking item navigates to /results/{id}
No page/console errors during full UI walkthrough
action_items: None from testing. Optional observation: for the seeded 'Al-Noor Mosque / Houston, TX' run the overall_score was 0 (entity not mentioned by any engine) which is expected for a generic name - no bug, just noting for product review.
